o.text: Internationalism, ultimately from Latin capitāneus, likely via Russian капитан (kapitan).
From Proto-Turkic *yǖk (“load; to load, carry”). Cognate to Turkish yük, Chuvash ҫӑк (śăk), Kazakh жүк (jük), Southern Altai јӱк (ǰük, “load, cargo, burden”), etc.
